messages:
Maya (CS): Quick thread — I'm drafting a go-live touchpoint runbook for Acme's onboarding. goal: avoid cold-start latency and give clear renewal-risk signals.
Omar (FieldOps): Love it. Can you add the minimal prefill flow + how to trigger warm pools? :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Planned sections: 1) prefill/warmup, 2) cache priming, 3) batch config for low-latency rps, 4) streaming handshake fallback, 5) telemetry + renewal signals.
Eileen (SRE): Suggestion: include a tiny health-check curl that we can run from customer's infra and our probe. saves time. example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prompts":["Hello","Hi"]}'
```
Omar (FieldOps): Add a note: set batch.max_ms to 20ms for interactive flows, but allow 100ms for bulk migration. Also enable prefix cache for top-3 intents.
Sam (PM): For enablement: include a one-pager for product team with expected cost delta for different quantization/batching settings. PMs will use it in 7d check-in.
Maya (CS): Renewal risk criteria proposal: activation < 40% of target calls by day 7 -> flag as "at-risk"; also if error rate > 3% for 48h.
Eileen (SRE): Telemetry to capture: token latency p50/p95, read-back cache hit rate, KV cache miss spikes, streaming reconnects. Add Grafana dashboard links.
RedwoodBot: deploy-bot: New runbook doc created - https://console.redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/runbooks/acme-touchpoint
Omar (FieldOps): Operational fallback: if streaming handshake fails 3x, fallback to short-polling stream with keepalive 15s. Log sample:
```
[WARN] stream->fallback at 2026-03-19T11:22:01Z tenant=acme reason=handshake_timeout
```
Maya (CS): Can someone own the customer prefill task? I'll coordinate the enablement call.
Omar (FieldOps): I can take prefill and warm-pool setup. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Eileen (SRE): I'll add SLO checks and the alert rule for error rate > 3%.
Sam (PM): I'll prepare the one-pager and run the 7-day activation checklist.
Maya (CS): Great — assigning: Omar (prefill/warm-pool), Eileen (SLOs/alerts), Sam (one-pager), Maya (enablement + renewal watch). Thanks team :heart:
Maya (CS): Posting final checklist draft to the doc now — please comment in the doc if anything missing: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/runbooks/acme-touchpoint#checklist
